FVTTATLAS.Settings.ShowStartupNotice.Hin: When enabled, show the GM a notification after the world loads. This is a diagnostic only.
FVTTATLAS.Notifications.Ready: FVTT Atlas Navigation: Module loaded successfully.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.NoScene: No Scene is currently viewed. Open a Scene on the canvas and try again.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Enabled: Use this Scene as an atlas
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.EnabledHint: Turning this off hides atlas functionality but preserves its stored network for later.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.ScaleHint: Manual override: units represented by one image pixel. Use Scene Grid instead when its values are correct.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.UnitHint: Manual override only. Short unit such as km or mi.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.OneEditor: Development limitation: only one GM should edit an atlas at a time. Changes by another GM while this dialog is open will be rejected when detected.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Saved: Atlas settings saved for this Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.SceneSettingsHint: Per-Scene Atlas status and measurement. Roads, Waypoints, and Region lists will be added here in the next Phase 2 slices.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Inactive: Atlas not yet enabled for this Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.MeasurementSourceHint: By default, Atlas follows this Scene's Grid distance and units. Select Manual only when its map-scale differs. The choice is per Scene.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.GridUnavailable: This Scene has no usable Grid distance, pixel size, and unit. Set those in the Grid tab or enter a manual scale.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.Uncalibrated: No valid distance scale is available yet.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.ManualScaleHint: Used only with Manual scale override. Enter positive travel units per image pixel; leave blank to remove the manual override.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.ManualUnitHint: Used only with Manual scale override. Enter a short unit code using letters (e.g. km or mi).
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.ScaleDifference: Your saved manual scale differs from the Scene Grid. It is being preserved; switching sources requires your explicit selection.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.SwitchToGridWarning: Switching to Scene Grid and saving removes the old manual calibration. Its current values remain visible above until you save.
FVTTATLAS.Atlas.SceneGridSaveHint: Save any changes in the native Grid tab first; Atlas reads the Scene's saved Grid data. Exact hex/gridless route measurement will be checked during road editing.
